Procedure_Name: Sales Ledger to General Ledger Tie-Out
Analytical_Objective: Verify mathematical agreement between ERP sales register and trial balance revenue accounts
Required_Data_Inputs: Sales invoice subledger credit memo register trial balance GL detail
Step_by_Step_Execution: Extract all sales invoices and credit memos aggregate by GL account compare to P&L revenue
Forensic_Red_Flags: Unreconciled variances >0.5% unexplained manual JEs in revenue accounts
Mathematical_Formulas: Total Sales = Sum(Invoices) - Sum(Credit Memos) - Discounts
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Baseline verification; discrepancies trigger investigation before testing
Double_Counting_Firewall: Ensures starting top-line ties to Workstream 03 and audited FS

Analytical_Objective: Expose true customer concentration by aggregating child billing accounts to parent entities
Required_Data_Inputs: Customer master table billing accounts corporate ownership registries
Step_by_Step_Execution: Extract customer tax IDs parent company names roll up subsidiary account balances
Forensic_Red_Flags: Single customer disguised across 20 regional shipping accounts
Mathematical_Formulas: Concentration Share = Parent Revenue / Total Revenue
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Adjusts concentration ratios and risk assessment; no P&L dollar adjustment
Double_Counting_Firewall: Affects Pareto curve without modifying total reported revenue

Analytical_Objective: Deconstruct top-line revenue variance into pure price unit volume and product mix effects
Required_Data_Inputs: Line-item sales ledgers SKU master files unit shipment counts unit price cards
Step_by_Step_Execution: Group by product family compute base period unit price calculate price volume and mix deltas
Forensic_Red_Flags: Volume contraction masked by emergency inflation surcharges; negative mix shift
Mathematical_Formulas: Delta Rev = Price Effect + Volume Effect + Mix Effect
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Informs sustainability of gross margin; isolates temporary pricing spikes
Double_Counting_Firewall: Reconciles exactly to reported revenue variance; zero leakage

Analytical_Objective: Measure multi-year retention decay curves and organic expansion across acquisition vintages
Required_Data_Inputs: Customer transaction history with initial acquisition dates annual billing totals
Step_by_Step_Execution: Assign each customer to acquisition vintage track revenue contribution across subsequent fiscal years
Forensic_Red_Flags: Steep cohort decay (>15% annual churn) masked by aggressive new customer acquisition
Mathematical_Formulas: GRR = (Start ARR - Churn - Contraction) / Start ARR; NRR = (Start ARR + Expansion - Churn) / Start ARR
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Underwrites top-line forecast; identifies unmaintainable growth trajectories
Double_Counting_Firewall: Cohort analysis measures commercial sustainability without altering historical GAAP

Analytical_Objective: Quantify enterprise vulnerability to top account terminations or volume reductions
Required_Data_Inputs: Multi-year customer revenue rankings contract terms expiration dates
Step_by_Step_Execution: Rank customers by revenue compute Top 5 10 20 shares evaluate contract renewal dates
Forensic_Red_Flags: Top 5 customers represent >40% of revenue; top account contract expiring within 6 months
Mathematical_Formulas: HHI = Sum((Market Share * 100)^2); Top N Share = Sum(Top N) / Total Revenue
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Identifies run-rate haircut risk; supports customer retention escrows
Double_Counting_Firewall: Does not adjust historical EBITDA unless account has already churned

Analytical_Objective: Identify loss-making accounts and quantify cross-subsidization across customer portfolio
Required_Data_Inputs: Customer sales gross margin freight-out tracking returns customer-specific opex
Step_by_Step_Execution: Allocate direct COGS and variable cost-to-serve rank accounts from highest to lowest margin
Forensic_Red_Flags: Top 20% of accounts generate 140% of profit; bottom 10% destroy significant cash
Mathematical_Formulas: Cumulative Margin % = Running Sum(Customer Margin) / Total Margin
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Guides commercial carve-outs or price restructuring; highlights volume risk
Double_Counting_Firewall: Cost-to-serve freight already in P&L; prevents double counting in opex

Analytical_Objective: Detect premature revenue recognition and period-end billing pull-forwards
Required_Data_Inputs: Sales invoices bills of lading (BOL) shipping logs proof of delivery (POD)
Step_by_Step_Execution: Sample transactions 15 days before and after year-end match invoice date to physical carrier delivery date
Forensic_Red_Flags: Disproportionate shipments in final 3 days; goods held on dock under FOB Destination
Mathematical_Formulas: Margin Haircut = Accelerated Revenue - Matching Cost of Goods Sold
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Mandatory QoE deduction reversing premature gross profit from historical EBITDA
Double_Counting_Firewall: Companion audit adjustment reverses AR and restores inventory in WS07 NWC

Analytical_Objective: Uncover unrecorded returns pricing disputes or concealed concessions issued after year-end
Required_Data_Inputs: Credit memo register for first 90 days post year-end matching original invoices
Step_by_Step_Execution: Inspect credit memos filter for items referencing prior-year shipments analyze dispute reasons
Forensic_Red_Flags: Cluster of credit memos in January/February reversing December sales spikes
Mathematical_Formulas: Unrecorded Dilution = Sum(Post-Close Credit Memos related to Prior Period)
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Mandatory QoE deduction to reduce prior-period revenue and EBITDA
Double_Counting_Firewall: Credit memos must be deducted from revenue rather than expensed in opex

Analytical_Objective: Verify that supplier volume rebates are earned and properly matched to purchase volume
Required_Data_Inputs: Vendor rebate agreements supplier purchase volume ledgers rebate credit memos
Step_by_Step_Execution: Examine rebate tier thresholds compare actual annual purchases to required contract tiers
Forensic_Red_Flags: Booking top-tier rebate income when actual purchasing volumes fell short of threshold
Double_Counting_Firewall: Mandatory QoE deduction reversing unearned rebate credits from gross margin

Analytical_Objective: Validate legal enforceability of firm sales commitments vs speculative sales pipeline
Required_Data_Inputs: Master service agreements purchase orders customer backlog reports cancellation logs
Step_by_Step_Execution: Sample open backlog orders inspect binding PO numbers verify delivery dates and termination clauses
Forensic_Red_Flags: Backlog includes soft quotes or contracts with termination for convenience on 30-day notice
Mathematical_Formulas: Backlog Conversion Rate = Verified Billed Orders / Historical Backlog
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Underwriting validation; excludes uncommitted pipeline from maintainable run-rate
Double_Counting_Firewall: Qualitative commercial risk factor; prevents speculative prospective EBITDA add-backs

Procedure_Name: Drop-Ship Gross vs Net Revenue Accounting
Analytical_Objective: Ensure compliance with ASC 606 principal vs agent guidance on third-party fulfilled sales
Required_Data_Inputs: Drop-ship sales orders vendor invoices shipping documentation carrier tracking
Step_by_Step_Execution: Determine whether entity takes inventory risk and directs fulfillment or acts as broker
Forensic_Red_Flags: Recognizing gross sales on drop-shipped goods without bearing inventory or credit risk
Mathematical_Formulas: Net Revenue = Gross Invoiced Amount - Third-Party Supplier Cost
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Reclassification of gross revenue and matching COGS; zero net EBITDA impact
Double_Counting_Firewall: Reduces reported top-line and increases gross margin % without altering EBITDA

Analytical_Objective: Test accuracy of estimated-costs-to-complete (EAC) on long-cycle engineering contracts
Required_Data_Inputs: Project job cost ledgers EAC estimates milestone billing schedules timesheets
Step_by_Step_Execution: Sample active contracts compare actual costs incurred to budget review engineering estimates
Forensic_Red_Flags: Sudden gross margin deterioration at project completion; failure to accrue expected contract losses
Mathematical_Formulas: POC % = Cumulative Costs Incurred / Total Estimated Project Costs
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Mandatory QoE deduction for unrecorded contract loss provisions (ASC 606-10-65)
Double_Counting_Firewall: Loss provision reduces current period EBITDA; balances with contract liabilities

Analytical_Objective: Quantify post-closing revenue write-down resulting from purchase accounting fair value rules
Required_Data_Inputs: Deferred revenue aging schedule customer contract fulfillment cost breakdown
Step_by_Step_Execution: Determine legal performance obligation costs plus normal profit margin compare to recorded unearned revenue
Forensic_Red_Flags: Large upfront cash collections consumed by seller leaving buyer with uncompensated obligations
Mathematical_Formulas: ASC 805 Haircut = Recorded Deferred Revenue - (Cost to Fulfill + Normal Profit)
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Pro-forma balance sheet haircut reducing post-close GAAP revenue; excluded from cash run-rate
Double_Counting_Firewall: Balance sheet fair value adjustment; does not penalize historical cash flow

Analytical_Objective: Annualize the full-year margin loss of accounts that terminated during or post-review period
Required_Data_Inputs: Customer termination notices CRM churn logs post-period monthly sales registers
Step_by_Step_Execution: Identify customers who ceased ordering compute trailing 12-month revenue and contribution margin
Forensic_Red_Flags: Major customer left in Q3 but historical full-year EBITDA still includes 9 months of margin
Mathematical_Formulas: Run-Rate Haircut = -(Lost Customer Trailing Revenue * Customer Gross Margin %)
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Diligence haircut adjusting LTM baseline earnings downwards for transaction pricing
Double_Counting_Firewall: Adjusts run-rate baseline; distinct from historical GAAP normalized EBITDA

Procedure_Name: Channel Stuffing & Quarter-End Hockey Stick Audit
Analytical_Objective: Detect deliberate acceleration of sales to beat quarterly targets through extended terms
Required_Data_Inputs: Daily sales logs shipping manifests customer payment terms aging ledgers
Step_by_Step_Execution: Plot daily revenue distribution across quarter identify spikes in final 5 days compare to return rates
Forensic_Red_Flags: 40% of quarterly sales booked in final week accompanied by extended Net 120-day payment terms
Mathematical_Formulas: Hockey Stick Index = Final 5 Days Revenue / Total Quarterly Revenue
Diligence_Adjustment_Mechanism: Reversal of premature revenue and reclassification to consignment inventory
Double_Counting_Firewall: Reduces current period EBITDA and removes fictitious receivables from NWC
